jobs.name: Ball washer
jobs.brief: One dark-green pedestal ball washer with round base, cylindrical brush cup, hinged lid, ball opening, wooden-grip hand crank on model right and white towel hanging model left. Keep lid/crank/towel on those same physical sides across8views; no person.

Preserve hopper, front outlet and bucket position; do not replace it with a bare bucket rack.

Redesign as ordinary1950scourse water station: galvanized rectangular cistern on a bolted practical steel/timber stand, two taps, one drip trough, rear fill cap. Keep tank/plumbing roles; remove blue plastic tarp, ropes and modern IBC cage.

Preserve two markers and their physical relative positions across8views. Remove the baked grass/soil rectangle; no new plants or ground tile.

Preserve gate/ramp geometry; do not generate a long generic rope corridor. Gate leaves remain fixed open at the same angles.

jobs.name: Direction signpost
jobs.brief: One green pedestal fingerpost with exactly four arrow boards: upper-left golf icon, upper-right food icon, lower-left toilets icon, lower-right exit icon. Keep arrows physically attached to fixed sides; backs may be plain. No captions or invented destination text; small intrinsic pictograms allowed. Ignore detached neighbour fragment at source top.

Preserve board architecture and fixed12identity, but tiny yardage numerals may stay blank for data. Remove baked grass/soil apron and ignore detached bottom neighbour fragment.

jobs.brief: One freestanding roofed course information/map board with green timber surround, broad cream map panel, shallow pitched roof and information symbol above. Preserve the actual board and back structure; switch lanterns off for daylight. Omit the integrated flower planters and paving slab, retaining only structural supports.
